shared_elements: multiple animals combined on one surface
roughly horizontal registers/banding of the composition
disc-like/rounded element (A: painted patch; B: carved disc)
justification: Both surfaces depict profile quadrupeds together with small schematic anthropomorphic figures on a broad field organised into loose horizontal zones, which is the most specific correspondence but also a fairly generic one. They differ fundamentally in scheme: A shows one dominant large animal swarmed by tiny stick-like human figures in an apparent hunt/baiting scene, whereas B stacks discrete animals (a row of quadrupeds, a predator with a disc, a large bird, plant-like fronds) in separate registers with no interaction between them, and B's animals are modelled and detailed while A's figures are linear silhouettes.
